rubric: Frame and assumptions stated; a countdown with the four stages (weeks before, one week, day before, the day) and a run of the day with clock times.
Food and drink quantities computed from the guest number with the stated amounts; children counted as half for food.
To-do and shopping grouped (food, drinks, tableware, decoration, activities, other); budget as ranges with a note to check prices.
A children's party has at most 5 activities, food halfway, cake near the end, adult ratio named; diet rules and allergies kept.
The two often-forgotten items for this kind of event; no invented venue, supplier or price.
